children: Yue (Justin) Tang Proposes Buyout of X Financial with 47.97% Stake

Yue (Justin) Tang reported beneficial ownership of 47.97% of X Financial and disclosed that Mangrove Coast Investment Limited proposed buying the shares it does not already own. The proposal, submitted to X Financial’s board on November 6, 2026, offers $6.03 in cash per American depositary share, or $1.005 per ordinary share. The preliminary offer could take X Financial private and remove its American depositary shares from the New York Stock Exchange, but it does not commit either side to complete a deal.

Mangrove’s preliminary, non-binding proposal seeks to acquire all X Financial ordinary shares it does not beneficially own. Mangrove expects to fund the purchase with a mix of equity from Mangrove and its affiliates, including cash or rolled-over equity, and loans from financial institutions.

The parties still need to negotiate and sign final agreements, and neither side has to complete the proposed transaction. If they do complete it, X Financial’s American depositary shares would become eligible for deregistration and delisting from the New York Stock Exchange.

Yue (Justin) Tang is a Malta citizen and serves as X Financial’s chairman and chief executive officer. He is the settlor of the Mangrove Coast Trust, whose beneficiaries include Tang and his family, and he serves as the sole director of Mangrove Coast Investment Limited. The trust owns Mangrove, an investment-holding company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands.
